name: 3DBench
description: A scalable benchmark for instruction-tuning and evaluating 3D-focused large language models on object- and scene-level tasks in 3D environments.
evaluation_method: human_eval and task_success_rate for instruction-following; task-specific automatic metrics (BLEU/EM/accuracy) when applicable
general_score_metric: task_success_rate / human evaluation (primary for many tasks)
reputation: A recent, specialized benchmark emerging for 3D-focused instruction-tuning and evaluation of multimodal/3D LLMs; adoption is growing but still limited relative to 2D vision benchmarks.
notes: Evaluation often requires human judgment or task-specific automatic measures; models can be sensitive to availability of 3D assets in training data (contamination risk) and benchmark adoption is still nascent.
